name: The Atrium: Proctor Bell's Meet-and-Greet
read_aloud: A glass booth squeals along its ceiling rail and stops in front of you. The wooden fortune-teller inside clacks its jaw and introduces itself as your teacher. It points at a security shutter jammed halfway up, which is apparently the way out.
narrator_line: A glass booth squeals along its ceiling rail and stops in front of you.
layout: A three-story concrete atrium around a dead fountain, smooth jazz from the ceiling speakers, and a glass booth on ceiling rails holding Proctor Bell, a painted wooden fortune-teller.

exits.name: The jammed security shutter, onward to Vent Row (Z2).
Back to the Intake Hall booths (Z0).

features.name: The fountain rim (half cover if it ever matters).
The jammed shutter (Strength (Athletics); check value in 00-overview.md section 5.1).
Sharp-edged fountain coins (Dexterity (Sleight of Hand); section 5.1).

quick_run.setup: A dead fountain, smooth jazz, and a fortune-teller booth that glides in to teach d20 tests.
quick_run.decision: Lift the stuck shutter together, read the directory, or pay Proctor Bell for a hint?
quick_run.on_success: The shutter goes up, the System Map shows Z1 to Z6, and the Crawlers move on.
quick_run.on_failure: They fumble the shutter; Proctor Bell sells a hint and the Help action gets them through.
quick_run.cut_short: One Athletics check with Help for the shutter; skip the fountain and the directory.

loot.text: Fountain coins (corroded, a sharp edge) and Proctor Bell's one-credit hint (00-overview.md section 5.1).

gm_notes: Strong-model notes stay on the Day page. This stub does not copy if_they_do_something_dumb.
